t: FM17: Over 700 Delegates to Shape the Future of Malta’s Financial Services
html:
FinanceMalta has officially closed registrations for its 17th Annual Conference after surpassing expectations with over 700 delegates confirmed. This record turnout underscores the strong confidence in Malta’s financial services jurisdiction and the commitment of stakeholders to shaping the sector’s future.

The conference will bring together an impressive line-up of stakeholders from Malta and abroad, European Union policymakers, Maltese Government representatives, officials from global standard-setting organisations, renowned academics, researchers, and other key figures.

The event, chaired by Sorcha Hellyer, Founder of Image Diplomacy & iD Creative Solutions and Official Representative for BBC News, will address critical topics in the financial industry. It will also delve into innovative niches such as the blue economy and the financing of aircraft leasing while tackling topical issues such as addressing skills shortages and enhancing trust in the jurisdiction.

Prominent keynote speakers will include representatives from the International Monetary Fund, Mastercard, Malta Financial Services Authority (MFSA), Malta Business Registry (MBR), the Financial Intelligence Analysis Unit (FIAU), the Malta Stock Exchange (MSE), and the Malta Financial Services Advisory Council (MFSAC), among others.

FinanceMalta expresses its gratitude to Moneybase as the main supporter of the Conference as its Diamond Sponsor, as well as Dominion for sponsoring a networking event on the eve of the conference at the iconic Casino Maltese.
